description: This file defines the class PolicyEntryNotModifiableException, a specialized exception subclass used to indicate that a PolicyEntry could not be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON, and a builder class for constructing instances with detailed context.

classes.name: PolicyEntryNotModifiableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a policy entry cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException. Includes static factory methods and a nested builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class providing a mutable builder pattern for creating instances of PolicyEntryNotModifiableException. Supports setting message, description, cause, href, and headers, with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance initialized with specified PolicyId and label.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntryNotModifiableException from a string message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntryNotModifiableException from a JsonObject representing the error, with headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the provided Ditto headers, copying other properties from the current instance.
